# source: natbib manual §2.3 (basic citation commands), §2.4 (starred and
# capitalized variants, \citetext/\citenum), §2.5 (aliases and style:
# \defcitealias, \setcitestyle, \bibpunct), §2.9 (package options), and
# natbib.sty's own command table, option list and header. The citation
# commands are one table (Ir.natbibCites) read by one arm, and one
# renderer (Bib.renderCite) draws every form under the document's
# punctuation: the load's options and the preamble's declarations
# replayed over natbib's load values, then the bibliography style's own
# row while natbib's \bibstyle door stays open (Bib.CitePunct.ofDoc).
# The options outside the punctuation vocabulary are named and dropped.
# The lines lualatex sets for each row are natbibChecks' expectations.
# \citestyle{name} applies natbib's row for the name with the door shut
# (natbibCiteStyleChecks). The list's own spacing is \bibhang and \bibsep
# (natbibListChecks). Its other hooks — \bibfont, \bibnumfmt, \bibsection,
# \bibpreamble, \citenumfont — have no rows yet: a redefinition of one is
# read as a macro nothing calls, a loss the definer does not name.
body impl \citep{k}
body impl \citet{k}
body impl \cite{k}
body impl \citep*{k}
body impl \citet*{k}
body impl \citep[chap.~2]{k}
body impl \citep[e.g.,][]{k}
body impl \citep[see][pg.~34]{k}
body impl \citealt{k}
body impl \citealt*{k}
body impl \citealp{k}
body impl \citealp*{k}
body impl \Citet{k}
body impl \Citep{k}
body impl \Citeauthor{k}
body impl \citeauthor{k}
body impl \citeauthor*{k}
body impl \citeyear{k}
body impl \citeyearpar{k}
body impl \citetext{priv.\ comm.}
body impl \citenum{k}
body impl \nocite{k}
pre refuse:W0301 \defcitealias{k}{ali}
body refuse:W0301 \citetalias{k}
body refuse:W0301 \citepalias{k}
pre impl \setcitestyle{square}
pre impl \setcitestyle{numbers}
pre impl \setcitestyle{authoryear}
pre impl \setcitestyle{open={(},close={)}}
pre impl \setcitestyle{aysep={},yysep={;}}
pre impl \setcitestyle{notesep={; },citesep={;}}
pre refuse:W0101 \setcitestyle{super}
body refuse:W0340 \setcitestyle{square}
pre impl \bibpunct{(}{)}{;}{a}{,}{,}
pre impl \bibpunct[; ]{[}{]}{,}{n}{}{,}
pre impl \citestyle{chicago}
pre impl \setlength{\bibhang}{2em}
pre impl \setlength{\bibsep}{0pt}
body impl \shortcites{k}

pre impl \usepackage[nobibstyle]{natbib}
pre impl \usepackage[bibstyle]{natbib}
pre refuse:W0101 \usepackage[super]{natbib}
pre impl \usepackage[sort]{natbib}
pre impl \usepackage[compress]{natbib}
pre impl \usepackage[sort&compress]{natbib}
pre refuse:W0101 \usepackage[longnamesfirst]{natbib}
pre refuse:W0101 \usepackage[sectionbib]{natbib}
pre refuse:W0101 \usepackage[nonamebreak]{natbib}
pre refuse:W0101 \usepackage[openbib]{natbib}
pre refuse:W0101 \usepackage[mcite]{natbib}
pre refuse:W0101 \usepackage[merge]{natbib}
pre refuse:W0101 \usepackage[elide]{natbib}
pre inert:binds \bibliographystyle{plainnat}
